title: Parts of Speech and Word Formation — Level 4 — Find the mistake

tags.kisi-kisi: Parts of Speech and Word Formation

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the speech contest.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confidently in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confidently in front of the judges.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confident in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confident in front of the judges.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confidence in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confidence in front of the judges.

visual.text: Dimas spoke confide in front of the judges.

choices.say: Dimas spoke confide in front of the judges.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) government made an (B) announce that all (C) schools would (D) close early."
items.reteach: Setelah "an" diperlukan noun: announcement, bukan verb "announce".

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The tourists were very (A) happiness with the (B) beautiful view (C) of (D) Bromo."
items.reteach: Setelah "were very" diperlukan adjective: happy, bukan noun "happiness".

items.prompt: Choose the sentence in which every word form is correct.

visual.text: Her kindness made the new student feel welcome.

choices.say: Her kindness made the new student feel welcome.

visual.text: Her kindly made the new student feel welcome.

choices.say: Her kindly made the new student feel welcome.

visual.text: Her kindness made the new student feel welcomely.

choices.say: Her kindness made the new student feel welcomely.

visual.text: Her kind made the new student feel welcomely.

choices.say: Her kind made the new student feel welcomely.

items.reteach: Subjek "Her ___" perlu noun (kindness); setelah "feel" perlu adjective (welcome).

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) unhonest seller (B) cheated his (C) customers (D) repeatedly."
items.reteach: Lawan kata honest memakai prefix dis-: dishonest, bukan "unhonest".

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "Please (A) reread the text (B) careful and (C) underline the (D) main ideas."
Which part is kurang tepat? "Many people (A) disagree with the (B) decision because it seems (C) unfairly to (D) farmers."
items.reteach: Setelah linking verb "seems" dipakai adjective: unfair.

items.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the lost wallet.

visual.text: It is impossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is impossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

visual.text: It is unpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is unpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

visual.text: It is dispossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is dispossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

visual.text: It is inpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

choices.say: It is inpossible to find the wallet in this crowd.

items.reteach: Lawan kata possible adalah impossible (prefix im- sebelum huruf p).

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) teacher praised our (B) creative and (C) usefull (D) presentation."
items.reteach: Suffix -ful hanya memakai satu l: useful.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "After the (A) heavy rain, the road became (B) slippery, so drivers had to brake (C) gentle and (D) carefully."
Choose the sentence that uses the word "misunderstand" correctly.

visual.text: I think you misunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you misunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

visual.text: I think you were misunderstand my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you were misunderstand my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

visual.text: I think you misunderstanded my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you misunderstanded my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

visual.text: I think you unmisunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

choices.say: I think you unmisunderstood my message; I meant Tuesday, not Thursday.

items.reteach: Misunderstand memakai bentuk lampau tidak beraturan: misunderstood.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "Her (A) happiness was (B) obvious when she (C) succeed in the (D) competition."
items.reteach: Kalimat lampau ("was") memerlukan verb lampau: succeeded.

items.prompt: Which part is kurang tepat? "The (A) movement of the dancers was (B) graceful, and the (C) audience clapped (D) enthusiastic."
